blocks.note: declares the base64 ratio table (`{bytes:3,characters:4}`) and `ds`, the decoder the cell check leans on: only the standard padded alphabet of whole characters is accepted

declares the ImageSource shape scalars and shapers — `sc` (a generation), `Df`/`ic` (the file-path and pixel-side ceilings), `fs` (a width and height), `F_` (the `file` form) — each turning its input into the bytes the swap path paints

declares the rest of the ImageSource machinery — `ps`/`uc`/`no`/`U_`/`G_`/`z_`/`K_`/`V_`/`Y_`/`X_`/`q_`/`J_` and `Mss`, the validator: a plain object carrying exactly one source form, with the refusal text `source must be { png }, { rgba, width, height }, { file, format } or { shm, format, width, height }` for every other shape

declares the Raster side of the blit: the check `fNs` (a requestId and key, then exactly one of `cells` or `source`, then numeric columns/rows), the cell helpers `xi`/`rb`/`Un`/`ms`/`Nf`/`ob`/`sb`/`ko`/`gs`/`Lf`/`xo` and the decoder `fur` (base64 of `columns*rows` cells), the denial helper `xDe`, the mounted-raster accessor `hs`, the other-plugin test `ib`, the lookup key `e5t`, the per-second window `ZPn`/`ab` and its limiter `qto`, the refusal text `Kto`, and the run `mNs`
declares the Image side of the blit: `Yj` (the mounted-image accessor), `a2t` (the other-plugin test), the run `kFo` and its `bFo` predicate
declares `QJt`, the separator the mounted-raster and mounted-image lookups join their key with
declares `fpr`, the control-character pattern over the character classes `b3` (imported below, carried by ./plugin-chain-source.ts), and `QT`, the test `F_` runs on a `source.file`
